caption: Found out I was paying for the same cover twice for who knows how long. Ever checked and regretted it?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R20 500
p/m salary
Living in Colesberg
slides.body:
Male, 34
Single, no kids
Job: Manages a roadhouse on the N1
Net salary: R20 500 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Staff room behind the roadhouse, meals not included
slides.body: It's cheap because it's basically at work. I haven't had a proper day off in months.

slides.title: Transport & fuel
slides.includes: Own bakkie, runs between here and town most days
slides.body: Being on the N1 means everything is a long drive away, including my own groceries.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: One supermarket in town, the rest from the roadhouse fridge
slides.body: I sell food all day and still spend this much feeding myself. Make it make sense.

slides.title: Duplicate debit order
slides.includes: An insurance add-on running alongside the one I actually use
slides.body: I only found this because the app flagged two policies doing the same job.

slides.title: Funeral policy
slides.includes: Cover for myself and my mother
slides.body: The one line item I've never once thought about cancelling.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Data & phone, electricity, medical aid, insurance, stokvel, clothing account
slides.body: Nothing dramatic on its own. Together it's a third of what I take home.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R20 500. Better than last month, now that I'm not paying for the same thing twice.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statements to Beyond Horizon and its anomaly check caught the duplicate policy in the first pass.

R850 a month, gone, just like that.

No bank login needed.
